title: Dead Drop
body: A blinking courier cache hums beneath a busted tram bench. The lock is cracked and nobody is claiming it.

choices.label: Crack the cache
choices.description: Pull a clean stack of credits before the owner can trace the ping.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.description: Leave the drop untouched and move on before it turns into a problem.

title: Street Clinic
body: A basement ripperdoc offers fast patchwork surgery under a neon privacy sheet. The work looks rough, but real.

choices.label: Pay for treatment
choices.description: Spend credits for emergency repairs and a quick reboot.

choices.label: Decline
choices.description: Keep your credits and limp onward.

title: Memory Scrubber
body: A gray-market technician offers to erase one combat routine from your stack. The process is permanent and surprisingly cheap.

choices.label: Scrub a card
choices.description: Delete one card from the deck forever.

choices.label: Keep the stack intact
choices.description: Back out before the scrubber touches your memories.

title: Black Ice Cache
body: A locked shard pulses with hostile countermeasures. If you force it open, something valuable may still be buried inside.

choices.label: Force the cache
choices.description: Take the backlash and rip out the protected combat routine.

choices.label: Leave it sealed
choices.description: The city will hand you another edge later.

title: Credit Shakedown
body: Two local enforcers block the alley and demand a "safety tax" for passing through their district.

choices.label: Pay the tax
choices.description: Lose credits and keep the peace.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.description: Take a beating rather than hand over your wallet.

title: Glitch Lottery
body: A hacked vending terminal invites you to spin a corrupted payout daemon. The odds are murky, but the jackpot is very real.

choices.label: Spin the daemon
choices.description: Risk credits, blood, or luck for a glitched payout.

outcomes.summary: You spoof the payout daemon and drain a hidden account.
The machine tags you with a neural burn before it unlocks.
The terminal skims your account before the exploit collapses.
A sealed payload cracks open and reveals a new combat script.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.description: Leave the roulette to someone else.
